A '''pipeline''' on [[Unidentified planet (Rhydonium heist)|a planet]] had that transported [[Rhydonium]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />  In [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Wilmon Paak]], [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]] used [[Rhydonium fuel pipe siphon|a piece of equipment]] to [[Rhydonium heist|steal]] an amount of Rhydonium from the pipeline.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pipeline appeared, though it was not identified, in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
